accuracy.body_dimensions: Xiaomi official metric enclosure dimensions; no stylized icon body dimensions. Corner radius and edge roll are photoestimates, not OEM CAD.
accuracy.screen_geometry: Official native portrait pixels and full rectangular display diagonal; estimated concentric corner radii and bezel selfie aperture. Pixel aspect preserved exactly.
accuracy.camera_geometry: Official product renders measured in this manifest. Camera width, height, margins and aperture positions are photoestimates; Pad 7 images are oblique and partly occluded. Bump depths 1.4-1.7mm, roll, rings, optics and decorative circles estimated; no OEM CAD claim.
accuracy.finishes: All ten existing icon finishes correspond to official color names. sRGB swatches reused from Documents brand_colors.json; metalness and roughness are visual estimates, not calibrated materials.
accuracy.branding: No Xiaomi entry exists in Documents brand_logos.json. Xiaomi wordmark traced from official Pad 6 rear render, complete letter outlines and counters constrained-triangulated; bottom-to-top in portrait and upright left-to-right in landscape, finish-tinted dark gray. Placement/size estimated.
accuracy.omissions: Ports, speaker grilles, antenna breaks, top-edge power key, small camera inscriptions and microscopic marks omitted. Pad 6 flash represented by a round emitter within its pill-shaped photographic highlight. Reference photographs are research-only and excluded from exports.

measurement.orientation: Portrait rear, right chassis occluded by front. Published height determines scale. Two active lenses on left, upper-right inscription circle, lower-right flash.
